project.name: x86OS
project.description: A simple x86 operating system kernel with FAT filesystem, GUI, multitasking, and networking support

nodes.name: types.h
nodes.summary: Defines fundamental integer types (int8_t, uint8_t, int16_t, uint16_t, int32_t, uint32_t, int64_t, uint64_t), string typedef, and size_t in the myos::common namespace. Platform abstraction layer for type definitions used throughout the kernel.

nodes.name: kernel.cpp
nodes.summary: Main kernel entry point. Initializes GDT, memory manager, interrupt handling, syscalls, PCI bus, drivers (keyboard, mouse, ATA), FAT filesystem, GUI desktop, and networking stack (Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP, TCP). Contains VGA text-mode printf utilities, keyboard/mouse/TCP/UDP handler classes, and the kernelMain function.

nodes.name: memorymanagement.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements a free-list-based memory allocator (MemoryManager::malloc/free) and global operator new/delete overrides that delegate to the active MemoryManager singleton.

nodes.name: memorymanagement.h
nodes.summary: Declares the MemoryChunk struct (linked-list node for free list) and MemoryManager class with static activeMemoryManager singleton, malloc, and free. Also declares global operator new/delete variants.

nodes.name: arp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP): handles incoming ARP request/response messages, broadcasts MAC addresses, resolves IP to MAC using an internal cache, and sends ARP requests.

nodes.name: arp.h
nodes.summary: Declares the ARP message struct (AddressResolutionProtocolMessage) and AddressResolutionProtocol class inheriting EtherFrameHandler, with IP-MAC cache and resolve/broadcast methods.

nodes.name: etherframe.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements EtherFrameHandler (base class for ethertype-specific handlers) and EtherFrameProvider that wraps an amd_am79c973 NIC driver. Dispatches incoming Ethernet frames to registered handlers by etherType, and provides Send/GetIPAddress/GetMACAddress methods.

nodes.name: etherframe.h
nodes.summary: Declares the EtherFrameHeader struct (dstMAC, srcMAC, etherType), EtherFrameFooter typedef, EtherFrameHandler base class, and EtherFrameProvider class inheriting RawDataHandler. Provides the handler dispatch mechanism.

nodes.name: icmp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP): handles ping echo requests (type 8) by replying with echo replies (type 0), and provides RequestEchoReply to send pings.

nodes.name: icmp.h
nodes.summary: Declares the InternetControlMessageProtocolMessage struct (type, code, checksum, data) and InternetControlMessageProtocol class inheriting InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: ipv4.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements InternetProtocolHandler (base for transport protocols) and InternetProtocolProvider. Handles IPv4 packet routing including header checksum calculation, subnet-based routing via gateway, and dispatching to protocol handlers by IP protocol number.

nodes.name: ipv4.h
nodes.summary: Declares InternetProtocolV4Message struct (IPv4 header fields), InternetProtocolHandler base class, and InternetProtocolProvider class inheriting EtherFrameHandler with ARP integration and checksum utility.

nodes.name: tcp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the full TCP state machine including connection establishment (SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK), data transfer, and teardown (FIN/ACK/CLOSE). Provides TransmissionControlProtocolProvider with Connect, Listen, Bind, Disconnect, Send operations and socket state management.

nodes.name: tcp.h
nodes.summary: Declares TCP socket states enum, flag enum, header/pseudo-header structs, and TransmissionControlProtocolHandler, TransmissionControlProtocolSocket, TransmissionControlProtocolProvider classes. Provider inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

nodes.name: udp.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements UDP datagram handling: UserDatagramProtocolProvider with Connect, Listen, Bind, Disconnect, Send operations and socket management. Dispatches received datagrams to registered handlers.

nodes.name: udp.h
nodes.summary: Declares UserDatagramProtocolHeader struct, and UserDatagramProtocolHandler, UserDatagramProtocolSocket, UserDatagramProtocolProvider classes. Provider inherits InternetProtocolHandler.

tour.title: Boot Entry Point
tour.description: Start at the Multiboot-compliant assembly loader that sets up a 2MB kernel stack, calls global constructors, and jumps to kernelMain with multiboot info.

tour.title: Kernel Initialization
tour.description: The main kernel entry point where all subsystems are initialized in sequence: GDT, MemoryManager, InterruptManager, PCI bus, drivers, FAT filesystem, GUI desktop, and the full networking stack. See the initialization order in kernelMain.

tour.title: Hardware Platform: GDT, Ports, Interrupts, PCI
tour.description: The x86 hardware abstraction layer: GlobalDescriptorTable for segmentation, I/O port abstractions (8/16/32 bit), PIC-based interrupt handling with IDT setup, interrupt stubs in assembly, and PCI bus enumeration with automatic driver discovery.

tour.title: Memory Management and Multitasking
tour.description: The kernel heap allocator using a free-list-based MemoryManager (with global operator new/delete overrides), and the cooperative multitasking system with round-robin scheduling and interrupt-based syscall dispatch.

tour.title: Device Drivers
tour.description: The driver framework and hardware drivers: Driver base class with lifecycle, PS/2 keyboard with scancode-to-ASCII mapping, PS/2 mouse with relative motion tracking, VGA graphics (320x200x256), ATA PATA storage driver, and the AMD Am79C973 Ethernet NIC driver with DMA descriptor rings.

tour.title: FAT Filesystem
tour.description: Full FAT12/16/32 filesystem implementation adapted from the Arduino SdFat library. Includes MBR partition table parsing, BIOS Parameter Block reading, FAT cluster chain management, directory traversal, and file read/write operations via SdFile/SdVolume classes.

tour.title: GUI: Desktop, Widgets, Windows
tour.description: The graphical user interface layer with a composite widget hierarchy: Widget base class with positioning and focus, CompositeWidget with child management and event dispatch, draggable Window, and Desktop with mouse cursor rendering. Uses VGA as the GraphicsContext.

tour.title: Network Stack: Ethernet to TCP
tour.description: A full network stack built on the AMD NIC driver: EtherFrameProvider dispatches by etherType, ARP resolves IP-to-MAC, IPv4 provides subnet-based routing, ICMP handles ping, and UDP/TCP provide transport-layer socket abstractions with a full TCP state machine.
